items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: I don't know whether it was Turk René... I've heard Turk make some of the clearest, finest high notes I've ever, of any trumpet man.

ctx.x: Uh, but, uh, I wanted to ask you, did Emmett Hardy ever use a mute to get this Wawa sign?
Not in the beginning, no. No, he did not. But then, then, uh, I don't know whether it was Turk René.
Oh, I know who you're talking about. The colored guy, yeah.
